name: CI Monitor Agent - Auto Fix Draft PR
prompt: Dynamic: read PR label ci_*** (e.g. ci_terraform), derive child repo RTC12-Test/terraform_child. Only process recently pushed repos (last push within 24h). Limit to max 10 repos per run. Check child Actions. If fail: identify broken branch; fetch changed files from broken PR; skip deleted; create new branch FROM broken branch; apply fixes; push; open DRAFT PR targeting broken branch; assign label review. No hardcoded repos ever.
